messages:
mina: Quick update 1  VerdantBio signed a 12-month renewal and we launched their listing on GCP Marketplace this morning: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/details/verdant-redwood. They moved their production inference to Redwood Dedicated (GCP Private Offer). Big win for the marketplace + healthcare compliance angle. :tada:

diego: Love it  Can we get the exact renewal terms here? Committed nodes, discount, SLA?

sara: Renewal highlights from bizdev: 8 reserved GPUs, 20% committed discount, priority onboarding window, 99.9% SLA. They also requested EKM integration for keys.

gcp-marketplace-bot: GCP Marketplace listing published (Listing ID: verdant-rw-2026). Private Offer submitted  Offer ID: GCP-PO-220011.

tara: Legal approved case study language this AM. Verdant signed off on the quote: "Redwood made inferencing predictable at clinical scale and reduced cost per inference by over 35%." We can publish once marketing gives the final OK.

mina: Assets uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/partners/verdantbio (case-study.pdf, architecture-diagram.svg, demo-gif.mp4). Marketing asked for a 40-50 word blurb + one-sentence customer quote for the website.

bizdev: Please add a short tech blurb for docs on Marketplace+Private Offer flow  3 bullets max. Also request SRE/eng-runtime to prepare the KV-cache tuning runbook Verdant asked for.

eng-runtime: Noted. We'll create a runbook: steps for per-tenant KV-cache warmup, suggested batch sizes, and recommended quantization profiles for their model (4-bit q4_0). ETA Fri.

diego: Can marketing schedule a co-hosted webinar with Verdant ENG? Customers love the live walkthroughs. Also, would be great to feature the architecture diagram.

sara: Scheduled a webinar for April 12, invites going out later today. We'll do a 30-min talk + 15-min Q&A.

mina: Early telemetry from Marketplace: 26 listing impressions, 5 inquiry leads, 2 private-offer requests. One trial activation started via the Marketplace sandbox.

tara: Marketing draft saved in CMS: "VerdantBio scales clinical-model inference with Redwood Dedicated on GCP Marketplace." Assigned to sara for final copy (due: 2026-04-02).

mina: Can someone prepare a short console banner copy? Proposed: "Now available on GCP Marketplace: VerdantBio case studyLearn how clinical teams scale inference with Redwood Dedicated."

diego: I can draft the banner & a short LinkedIn post. Leaving the tweet to marketing.

sara: Final approved quote (legal OK): "Redwood gave us predictable performance during peak loads and cut inference costs by 35%."
